news.headline: Niners' Nick Bosa on 4-game sack drought: 'Don't think I'm playing my best'
news.description: Niners star Nick Bosa acknowledged his performance this season, including four straight games with no sacks, hasn't been up to his usual standard.

news.headline: Florio, Simms apologize for comments about Vrabel's mustache in Germany
news.description: "PFT Live" hosts Mike Florio and Chris Simms apologized for comments they made about Mike Vrabel's mustache when talking about the Patriots' trip to Germany.

news.headline: TNF: Texans rule out DE Hunter, RB Marks; Colts rule out CB Ward, starting OTs
news.description: The Texans and Colts ruled out several key contributors for their Thursday night matchup.

news.headline: Giants RB Cam Skattebo to nix backflips in wake of Aidan Hutchinson's injury
news.description: Giants RB Cam Skattebo said he is holding off on doing any more backflips after Lions DE Aidan Hutchinson suffered a major knee injury while leaping and celebrating a sack.

news.headline: Panthers secondary set for boost with return of CB Mike Jackson
news.description: Panthers starting cornerback Mike Jackson, who has been sidelined since injuring his groin in Week 3, plans to be in the lineup Sunday against the Ravens.

news.headline: Ravens' Humphrey apologizes for quip that Baltimore 'best at making criminals'
news.description: Ravens cornerback Marlon Humphrey apologized Wednesday for the derogatory comment he recently made about Baltimore on his podcast.

news.headline: Jets QB Geno Smith (ankle) intends to play vs. Chargers: 'That's the plan'
news.description: Jets quarterback Geno Smith says he intends to play Sunday against the Chargers despite still walking with a noticeable limp due to an ankle injury.

news.headline: Ravens' Flowers 'super frustrated' by latest late-game fumble
news.description: Ravens wide receiver Zay Flowers said he was "super frustrated" after having the ball ripped away around midfield in the final two minutes of a loss to the Chargers on Monday night.

news.headline: Titans WR Wan'Dale Robinson out for season with ankle injury
news.description: Titans wide receiver Wan'Dale Robinson will miss the rest of the season due to an ankle injury, coach Robert Saleh said Wednesday.

news.headline: Sources: Brandon Aiyuk contacted Jayden Daniels to mend friendship with star QB
news.description: Brandon Aiyuk and Jayden Daniels have patched up their relationship after a falling out earlier this year, sources told ESPN.
